summary: Tested Pago a talleres Fase A end to end. Backend: 26 pytest cases covering workshop CRUD, normalization and validation, tariff CRUD and uniqueness, deactivation, both Excel imports, attachments and role permissions. 25 passed and 1 failed: the workshop Excel import removes a línea that still has tariffs. UI as admin: the hub card, KPIs, search and estado filter work. So do create (SearchSelect ciudad, checkboxes), the duplicate SAP toast, edit, deactivate with motivo, tarifarios tabs, tariff add/duplicate/edit/delete, PDF upload/view/delete, the read-only note for an inactive taller and the workshop import dialog (shows the updated and duplicates counts). Coordinador and lider see the module read-only, with no add, import, edit, toggle, upload or delete buttons. Tesorero and gerente do not see the card and are redirected to /. Their API calls get 403. Granting tp_talleres edit to coordinador lets coordinador create, and tarifarios stays 403. The matrix was restored to default. Other hub modules all load.

minor.issue: Skips the rule that blocks removing a línea with tariffs, which PUT /talleres/{id} enforces. Re-importing SAP X with lineas='cafe' removes 'blanca' even though blanca tariffs exist, so those tariffs are left orphaned. Reproduced in test_import_workshop_bypasses_linea_guard.

Updating an existing SAP overwrites optional fields (ruc, ciudad, direccion, contacto, telefono, correo) with blanks when the row's cells are empty. Reproduced: the UI import wiped the RUC 1790012345001 of an existing workshop. Also, empty lineas on an existing cafe-only workshop silently becomes blanca+cafe. Consider updating only non-empty cells for existing rows.

Numeric Excel cells for telefono and ruc lose their leading zero (0991234567 becomes 991234567; seed workshop 100245 already shows telefono 991234567). A 10-digit cédula starting with 0, typed as a number, becomes 9 digits and is rejected. Suggest zero-padding or forcing the template cells to text.
These still work for an INACTIVE taller (each returned 200), while the UI note says 'Taller inactivo · solo consulta'. Either block them in the backend or reword the note.

ui_bugs.issue: Edit and delete buttons (tariff-edit-*, tariff-delete-*) still show for an inactive taller, which contradicts the 'solo consulta' note. Only add and upload are hidden.

issues: 'Vigente desde' uses the browser's native <input type=date> instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover.
Heading reads '1 de 3 filas importadas' even when 1 row was also updated, so it looks like only 1 row was processed. The toast says '1 registros importados' (wrong plural).

action_items: In import_workshops, apply the same removed-línea-with-tariffs check as update_workshop and report it as a row error
In import_workshops, for existing SAPs, do not overwrite optional fields with empty cells (and do not default lineas for existing rows)
Keep leading zeros for numeric telefono and ruc cells from Excel
Decide the rules for inactive talleres: block tariff edit/delete and file upload in the backend, or hide edit/delete in the UI and change the note
Optional: replace the native date input with the shadcn calendar; fix the import result wording
critical_code_review_comments: router.py import_workshops runs a raw upsert $set of every field and bypasses the business rules enforced in update_workshop
update_tariff does not check w['activo'], which is inconsistent with create_tariff
The import endpoints have no file size limit (await file.read() with no cap)
The hub card links to /pago-talleres (dashboard placeholder), not /pago-talleres/talleres. That is acceptable, but noting it.

File view opens window.open('') and then navigates to a blob URL. In headless the popup stayed about:blank, so I could not confirm the preview visually. The GET /archivos/{id} bytes were verified in the API test.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows functional; 1 low UI inconsistency

seed_data_creation: Created only TEST* workshops (TEST<run>A/B/C and TEST<run>AX via pytest; TESTUI01, TESTUI02 and TESTINACT1 via UI/script), with their tariffs and files. All were hard-deleted afterwards by codigo_sap. Coordinador's role_permissions doc was created during the grant test and deleted afterwards; before the test there was no stored doc, so it is back to default. Main agent data (100245, 200300) was not modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_tallerpay_phase_a.py -n 0 (it is order-dependent, so do not run it with xdist). The test cleans up via Mongo by SAP codes from the run. test_import_workshop_bypasses_linea_guard is expected to fail until the import fix lands. Login testids: login-username-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button. Valid city example: AMBATO. /app/memory/test_credentials.md is missing; I used the credentials from the briefing. No tecnico credentials were provided, so the tecnico role was not tested.
